description: Create a new NAT Gateway instance in a VPC. Supports both Public (PBLIP) and Private (PRVT) types.

natGatewayDescription.description: Description for the NAT Gateway (max 1000 bytes)

natGatewayName.description: NAT Gateway name (3-30 chars, English letters/numbers/hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number)

privateIp.description: Private IP address. Ignored for PUBLIC subnet type. For PRIVATE subnet: auto-assigned if NULL, created with specified IP if provided.

publicIpInstanceNo.description: Public IP instance number. Ignored for PRIVATE subnet type. For PUBLIC subnet: auto-created if NULL, assigned if specified.

subnetNo.description: NATGW-type subnet number. If NULL, creates a PUBLIC-type NATGW subnet automatically. If specified, creates NAT Gateway according to the subnet's subnetTypeCode (PUBLIC or PRIVATE).

vpcNo.description: VPC number to create NAT Gateway in (from getVpcList)

name: ncloud_create_nat_gateway
